notes.title: 64 bit Mac version
notes.content: Changing the build to be a 64 bit build so newer models can play the game.

notes.title: Launch Day is here
notes.content:
A Curse From Beyond goes live today. I hope you like it, and I am deeply grateful for your attention to it. Give it a play, let me know what you think on Twitter at @the_cave_ghost or at my website caveghost.games/contact. Drop me a positive review if you feel so inclined. I hope to hear from you.

- the cave ghost
